method: a query is answerable when at least one of its scored candidates (scoring.scorable_ids) has a relevance judgment above 0; unanswerable queries score nDCG@10 = 0 for every ranking and leave the scored set. Rows already in the excluded-questions manifest stay listed so the exclusion count is unchanged.
basis: user decision for Decision Index 0.2.1: score only queries with at least one relevant candidate among the 32
